title: Call my mum

turns.owner_text: can you call my mum for me
turns.robot_text: I can’t place a phone call for you, Jae. But I can help you get ready—like what to say, or I can keep you company while you dial. If you want, I can suggest a simple message to start.

turns.owner_text: you're connected to the internet aren't you
turns.robot_text: Good question. I can help with things online, but I can’t directly connect to your phone or place calls. I’m here to chat, help you organize your thoughts, and point you toward what to do next.

turns.owner_text: so what can you actually do
turns.robot_text: Yeah, I can do a lot of helpful things, Jae—just not a few things like calling people or physically walking around. I can chat with you, listen to what’s on your mind, help you plan your day, draft a message to your mum, or give you quick info when you ask. I can also help you think through decisions, like a calm conversation partner.
Right, I can’t send messages on your behalf either. But I can help you write one—something simple and kind—so you can copy it into your phone.

I hear you, Jae—that does sound frustrating. I’m not able to send or place calls or messages, but I can still be useful by helping you craft something, think through what to say, or just keep you company while you handle it.

Hey, thanks for hanging in there with me. I get it—can feel a bit “okay, what then?” But I’m still here with you.

We can do something small and easy: I can help you write a quick note to your mum, or we can just chat about how you’re feeling tonight. Whatever you pick, I’m with you.
I’ll stay with you in spirit while you do it. You’ve got this—just take a breath, and if you want, come back after your call to tell me how it went.

notes: Captured live. Tool results were synthetic; no robot moved.
